text:
Updated `.sdlc/runs/20261104-refactor-react18-only/requirements.md` in `FR-7`, `NFR-3`, and `AC-6`:

- **`@backstage/cli-module-build` (`0.1.10-next.0`)**, **`@backstage/cli-module-test-jest` (`0.1.8-next.0`)**, and **`@backstage/repo-tools` (`0.19.3-next.0`)**: Reclassified as breaking changes with a `minor` bump (all below `1.0.0`) because the build and Jest tooling drop React 17 support and `peer-deps` stops accepting React 17 peer ranges.
- **`@backstage/cli-module-new` (`0.1.9-next.0`)**: Reclassified as a breaking change with a `minor` bump (below `1.0.0`) under the same rule because its scaffolding templates drop React 16/17 ranges and generate `^18.0.0`-only dependencies, breaking scaffolding in workspaces still on React 17.
- **`@backstage/ui` (`0.19.0`)**: Kept as a `patch` bump (below `1.0.0`) with explicit reasoning: it already required React `^18.0.0` in `peerDependencies`, so replacing `use-sync-external-store/shim` with `react`'s `useSyncExternalStore` and removing `use-sync-external-store` is purely internal.
- All `major` bumps for the 17 packages at `>= 1.0.0` and all other sections remain unchanged.
